messages:
carol_oncall: FYI hitting a weird combo in ord2 — KMS egress errors + CDN 502s. GPU attach failing, backlog in provisioning.
liam_net: seeing peering qps spikes to cloud KMS endpoint, lots of SYN_RETRIES. route table healthy though.
alice_sre: metric summary: attach_fail_rate ord2 from 00:12 UTC -> 18%. queued_provisioning ~120 pods, token refresh errors showing 504s.
carol_oncall: logs snippet: ```error=KMS_EGRESS_TIMEOUT host=kms.eu-cloud.example.com code=504 retryable=true```
ops-bot: deploy 197a queued, probes failing in ord2 cluster-3 (attach errors).
dave_runtime: can we short-circuit KMS calls for provisioning? we have local-kms-cache toggle on nodes but off by default.
liam_net: cloud-provider-bot reports "Peering capacity degraded, mitigation in progress" — not a full outage yet. ticket #CP-98321 opened.
carol_oncall: action plan: 1) enable local_kms_cache on new provisioner pool 2) shift new provisioning requests to eu1 for non-legal workloads 3) throttle token refresh to avoid stampede 4) customer comm.
maya_prod: agree. runbook step 4 says confirm HSM requests routed only when required. can we reduce KMS QPS by caching master key?
dave_runtime: pushing config patch to enable local_kms_cache=true for ord2-provisioner ASG. commands: ```kubectl patch ds provisioner -p '{"spec": {"template": {"metadata": {"annotations": {"local_kms_cache":"true"}}}}}'```
alice_sre: throttling: set provisioner concurrency to 12 -> will drop spike. rolling now.
helen_support: drafting status page: "We are seeing increased provisioning latency in ord2 due to third-party peering degradation affecting KMS and CDN paths. Mitigations in progress." would like ETA for public note.
liam_net: temporary routing change: failover prefix to transit-2 for KMS egress. applying now. will monitor whether QPS falls on primary peering.
ops-bot: autoscaler triggered extra dedicated-gpu pool in eu1: +8 nodes (reserved). cost note: will bill to emergency buffer.
cloud-provider-bot: update: peering capacity increased at 00:35 UTC, but egress latency on path A still high.
carol_oncall: pick: if ord2 still >10% attach_fail after 15m, shift traffic via smart-routing policy to eu1 for non-compliant jobs. can we tag jobs by compliance? dave?
dave_runtime: yes, adding route policy: `if workload.compliance != strict -> route=eu1` patching policy engine.
alice_sre: local_kms_cache rolled, provisioner concurrency throttled. queued_provisioning dropped from 120 -> 34 in 10m. attach_fail rate down to 7%.
helen_support: posting status now. added note about potential delayed start times for new VMs and temporary elevated costs.
maya_prod: thumbs. prepare rollback steps: disable local cache + revert routing when KMS egress stable.
carol_oncall: update final: cloud provider confirmed partial peering restore at 00:50 UTC, ord2 attach_fail 2.3%, backlog drained to 0 by 01:12 UTC. keeping monitoring for 2 hours. recommend postmortem to analyze KMS QPS shaping and pre-warming caches. :white_check_mark:
